privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This draft explains how information is handled when you visit MUUVA, explore products or use Guided Routines. It covers the website and the intended production analytics configuration. Final controller information and the legal assessment are still pending before publication.

operator.title: Who we are
operator.p1: MUUVA is the trading name of a sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak) established in the Netherlands, registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce under KvK 99637588. This notice concerns https://muuva.nl. For privacy questions or requests, contact contact@muuva.nl.

hosting.title: Visiting the website
hosting.p1: The website is delivered through Cloudflare Pages. Loading a page involves network requests that can include your IP address, browser information, the requested resource and the time of the request. Hosting and security services may process technical logs to deliver the website and protect it against abuse.
hosting.p2: This operational processing is separate from optional audience analytics. Turning analytics off does not prevent the technical requests needed to display the website or requests to embedded external services.

storage.title: Cookies and your language choice
storage.p1: When you manually select a language, MUUVA saves that choice in your browser’s localStorage under muuva.language. It remains until you change it or clear the website’s stored data in your browser. The language in the page URL takes priority. Automatic language detection does not save a preference.
storage.p2: MUUVA’s Umami implementation does not set analytics cookies. This does not mean the whole website is cookie-free: embedded third-party services may use cookies or similar technologies, depending on their settings and your browser.

analytics.title: Website analytics
analytics.p1: The production configuration for muuva.nl uses Umami Cloud on the Hobby plan, with analytics storage in the EU, for website analytics, traffic attribution and navigation analysis. Tracking is restricted to the exact hostname muuva.nl. Local and Preview builds remain disabled. Production activation is a separate step after review; this draft does not confirm that tracking is live.
analytics.p2: The approved configuration sends only the website identifier, hostname, approved public page path, approved localized page title, permitted campaign values and the origin of an external referring website. Other query values and anchors are removed. It excludes browser language and screen size, custom visitor identifiers, custom events, advertising pixels and session recordings. It respects the browser’s Do Not Track signal.
analytics.p3: Umami can process IP addresses and User-Agent information to calculate hashed session identifiers and derive metrics such as browser and device type. These identifiers are not a guarantee of anonymity. IP addresses may also occur in operational or security logs. EU analytics storage does not mean that every processing activity takes place within the EU. Activation remains subject to the privacy review.

videos.title: YouTube Guided Routines
videos.p1: Workout pages contain standard YouTube embedded players. Your browser contacts YouTube when the player loads, before you press Play. Google may receive your IP address, browser and request information, and may use cookies or associate activity with an account depending on its settings and your sign-in status.
videos.p2: YouTube’s independent processing is governed by Google’s privacy information. The review of privacy-enhanced embedding and loading only after a visitor’s action has been postponed. Neither change is implemented on the current website.

services.title: Fonts and external links
services.p1: Manrope and Newsreader are hosted with the MUUVA website. Your browser downloads these font files from the website’s own origin, without contacting Google Fonts. Hosting-related requests are covered by the website delivery information above.
services.p2: Amazon purchase links and Instagram links take you to external websites when you choose to follow them. They are links, rather than embedded advertising or social tracking scripts. Purchases take place on Amazon. Those services apply their own privacy terms.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.p1: The newsletter is not yet available. The footer displays a Coming soon message, with no subscription form. MUUVA does not collect email addresses through a newsletter form or register newsletter subscriptions on this website.

retention.title: Retention, legal grounds and transfers
retention.p1: Umami Hobby has a standard analytics retention period of six months. This is separate from operational or security logs and backup retention, whose applicable periods still require confirmation. Your language preference remains in your browser until changed or cleared. Hosting and external services have separate retention arrangements.
retention.p2: MUUVA proposes legitimate interests under GDPR Article 6(1)(f) for understanding website use and improving navigation, subject to the required assessment. The Dutch exception for analytics with limited privacy impact is also under assessment; no conclusion that consent is unnecessary has been approved. Relevant legal bases, provider retention details and safeguards for processing outside the European Economic Area must be finalized before publication and activation.

rights.title: Your privacy rights
rights.p1: Depending on the processing and applicable conditions, you may request access to your personal data, correction, erasure, restriction or portability, and you may object to processing. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, email contact@muuva.nl and describe your request.
rights.p2: You may complain to the Dutch Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens or the supervisory authority in the country where you live or work, or where an alleged infringement occurred. Requests about a provider’s independent processing can also be directed to that provider.

inspired.title: What Inspired Muuva?
inspired.intro: A brand inspired by a love for Pilates, the dream of building something meaningful, and the courage to begin again.
inspired.p1: Muuva was born during a moment of change in Michelle's life. Originally from Venezuela, she moved to the Netherlands for an opportunity in technology and spent more than eight years building her career as an engineer.
inspired.p2: When that chapter came to an end, she found herself wondering what she truly wanted to do next. She had always dreamed of creating something of her own, and for the first time, that dream started to feel possible.
inspired.p3: Pilates had always been her way to slow down, let go of stress, and reconnect with herself. Through busy days and uncertain moments, it was something that brought her a sense of balance and joy.
inspired.p4: She never imagined that something so personal could become part of her professional journey. But slowly, an idea began to take shape: why not create something that could help other women discover that same feeling and make movement a natural part of their everyday lives?
inspired.p5: With her engineering mindset, a passion for Pilates, and the excitement of starting something new, the first idea for Muuva came to life.
inspired.alt: Michelle seated beside a laptop with a MUUVA Pilates ball and ring in front of her.

us.title: About Us
us.p1: Muuva began with a shared dream between Michelle and her husband, Carlos: to create something meaningful together, built around something they genuinely love.
us.p2: Originally from Venezuela, they are both engineers who moved to the Netherlands to build a life together. With different strengths but a shared way of thinking, they approached their new adventure with curiosity, creativity, and the belief that even the biggest dreams begin with small steps.
us.p3: Building Muuva became more than starting a business. It was a chance to combine their experiences, learn something entirely new, and turn an idea into something they could call their own. Along the way, they discovered how much they could accomplish by supporting each other and bringing their different perspectives together.
us.p4: Today, Muuva is an Amsterdam-based Pilates brand created with heart, thoughtful design, and a genuine love for movement. More than beautiful Pilates essentials, they hope to inspire women to find joy in moving, take a moment for themselves, and make Pilates part of their everyday lives.
us.p5: At its heart, Muuva is a reflection of their love, their shared vision, and the courage to follow a dream together.
us.alt: Michelle and Carlos standing together, with Carlos smiling at Michelle.
